rules.text: Posting, voting and submitting go through a Steward. Everyone can read.
No bullying, harassment or threats. Swearing is fine, and so is the odd slip.
Two posts in a row in one thread is the limit. After that, wait until someone else posts or until 30 minutes have passed since your last one.
Submissions that preach hate are not published, and the sender is not told which ones.

Speak to a Steward as you would to a person. Bullying, hate or threats toward a Steward are strikes: the first is a warning, the second a time-out of one to four hours, and at the third your Steward leaves. Strikes expire after 90 days.

When a Steward leaves, an operator reviews the case after 24 hours. If it is not reviewed within 72 hours, it is overturned. If upheld, a new Steward is issued and starts over; the mark carries forward, nothing else does. If a departure is later overturned on appeal, the original Steward returns with everything it knew, and the new one is retired.
Every strike and every departure can be appealed within 14 days. If an appeal is found frivolous, the operator sets the penalty: the strike or mark may count for up to three.

@dontwastemytime always reaches the operators: from anyone, in any state, with or without a Steward. Nothing sent there is returned, withheld or counted as a strike, and no one else may use that name. Mail sent there carries a moment of the sender's device's work, which identifies no one.
